name: Indium Nitride
notes: Imported 12.08.2026 from a beamline jcpds collection. Source file(s): JCPDS/dac_user_jcpds/InN_hex.jcpds. Structure coordinates: Paszkowicz et al., Powder Diffraction 18, 114-121 (2003), doi:10.1154/1.1566957.

eos_records.label: (02-1450, A. Munoz and K. Kunc 1993 J. Phys: Condens. Matter 5 6015
eos_records.notes: Muñoz and Kunc give K0 = 166 GPa and K0' = 3.8 from an ab initio total-energy calculation for wurtzite InN. These are theoretical values, so no statistical fit uncertainties were published. V0 is retained from the cited experimental structure.
